interview:
Honest report: I did not win. Here's what happened:

1. I started the game by typing "Chonk" as the player name and pressing Play.
2. In the first game, I moved the cat down to the bottom-left corner, then tried to travel right along the bottom row toward the fish. One of my clicks was two squares away and was rejected, but I recovered and kept moving right.
3. After 4 moves, the guard dog caught up to the cat — the screen showed "Caught! The dog wins." I lost that game.
4. I pressed "Play again," which started a fresh game (Moves: 0, cat back at bottom-left, dog in the middle), but the session ended right at that point, before I could make any moves in the new game.

So my strategy of hugging the bottom row failed because the dog closed the distance faster than I could reach the fish. I never reached the fish and never won a game.
